title.narrative: Contribution to the End-term Evaluation of HSDIP-I, Validating HSDIP II and Harmonizing Health Facility Data to Inform Planning.

description.narrative:
The MoH conducted its recurring Joint Core Coordination Committee meeting on the 4th of November 2024, where a representative from the office of the Minister presented the HSDIP II/Health Sector Development and Investment Plan 2 preparation. The Ministry elaborated the objectives of developing the HSDIP II and its linkage with the national vision. Specific objectives such as to conduct comprehensive situational analysis of HSDIP-I, define strategic goals, objectives, and prioritize cost-effective interventions with high impact and align health sector priorities with national and global agendas (10-Year Plan, SDG-3, Agenda 2063).
The plan will also develop a costed implementation plan (CIP) with estimated resources and identify financing gaps and ensure inclusive stakeholder engagement of government, partners, CSOs, private sector with defined clear roles and responsibilities to enhance coordination and avoid duplication. It was during this meeting the Ministry requested for technical and financial support from donors/development partners.
